---
title: "Golden Retriever Health and Lifespan"
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    css: style.css
    toc: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

dogs <- read_csv("golden_retrievers.csv") |> 
  mutate(
    activity_level = factor(activity_level, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
    overall_health = factor(overall_health, levels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Excellent"))
  )
```

![A Golden Retriever](golden_retriever.png)

## Activity Level and Health

```{r}
#| label: activity-health-plot

dogs |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = activity_level, fill = overall_health)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "Golden Retriever Health by Activity Level",
    x = "Activity Level",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Overall Health"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Weight and Lifespan

```{r}
#| label: weight-lifespan-plot

dogs |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = weight_lbs, y = lifespan_years, color = gender)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Weight vs. Lifespan in Golden Retrievers",
    x = "Weight (lbs)",
    y = "Lifespan (years)",
    color = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
